name: sfai-marketplace
description: Claude Code plugins that bring Salesforce delivery practice to AI agents, built on superpowers and Salesforce's official plugins. Install those dependencies from their own marketplaces first; see README.md.

plugins.name: sfai-core
plugins.description: Bootstrap, project setup, naming standard, platform gotchas, automation patterns, verify command and Code Analyzer rules, branch lifecycle, review lens, hooks, lesson contribution. Required for everyone.

plugins.name: sfai-solutioning
plugins.description: Ticket stages 1 to 6: intake, impact analysis, UI design gate, solution design, UAT test cases. For architects, BAs and leads.

plugins.name: sfai-build
plugins.description: Ticket stages 7 to 13: Apex test-first, functional QA, safe deploy, logging. For developers, admins and QA.

plugins.name: sfai-project-updates
plugins.description: Personal update, weekly round-up, release notes. For PMs, leads and anyone asked for updates.

plugins.name: sfai-assessment
plugins.description: Org health assessment. For architects and leads.
